sampling_model.design: The data are an i.i.d. sample of marked blind two-replicate observations \(O_i=(Y_i,X_i,S_{i1},S_{i2})\). Identification is an enabling step; the focal object is a uniformly honest simultaneous whole-curve band over a fixed identified and explicitly inhabited class.
sampling_model.units: Superpopulation units have nonempty finite-stratum \(X_i\), compact latent dose \(A_i\), and potential-outcome schedules generated simultaneously by one jointly measurable response surface \(Y_i(a)=h(a,X_i,V_i)\), with \(V_i\perp A_i\mid X_i\). The surface range \([-B_Y,B_Y]\) implies a common-event schedule bound, observed-outcome boundedness by consistency, and conditional unconfoundedness; these are derived rather than separate primitive assumptions.
sampling_model.treatment: The replicates satisfy \(S_{i1}=A_i+U_{i1}\) and \(S_{i2}=A_i+U_{i2}\). The errors are independent, need not be identically distributed or symmetric, may have open spectral zero sets, obey a fixed \(q_e>1\) moment radius, and use only \(E[U_2]=0\) to fix location. Their protected near-zero modulus is derived from the moment bound.
sampling_model.overlap: The target interval is a nondegenerate compact subset of \(\operatorname{int}(\mathcal A)\), and \(f_x(a)\ge\kappa\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\), \(a\in I\). Primitive compatibility requires \(0<\kappa\le\kappa_0\), \(R_f\ge R_{f,0}\), and \(0<p_{\min}\le|\mathcal X|^{-1}\), which permits the explicit reference-density witness.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic profiling construction uses relaxed order-\(d\) B-spline families for \(f_x,q_x\), deterministic Sobolev-modulus inequalities, finite atomic characteristic-function families, and mass and channel confidence restrictions on \(\mathcal D_n\). The continuum inequalities are imposed exactly, so no finite decision algorithm or certified numerical approximation is claimed. A parallel abstract construction profiles the exact compact projected class \(\mathscr K\).
sampling_model.tails: The structural response range implies \(|Y(a)|\le B_Y\) on one common event and hence \(|Y|\le B_Y\) by consistency. Each measurement error has a fixed \(q_e>1\) absolute-moment bound \(M_e\).

body.tldr: The headline is statistical inference for a causal ADRF over an explicitly inhabited fixed class. A smooth reference-density/product-law construction proves that the model is nonempty, while the retained structural response surface derives both conditional unconfoundedness and bounded outcomes. Analytic cocycle identification enables the focal finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic constrained-sieve band, which is uniformly honest, clipped to \(0\le W_n\le2B_Y\), and has uniformly \(o(1)\) expected maximal width. A parallel abstract exact-class band has the same qualitative consistency conclusion. No finite decision algorithm, explicit \(O(r_n)\) rate, minimax match, or unconditional converse is claimed, and the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli lower modulus remains open.

project_justification.gap: Existing results do not give a quantitative simultaneous ADRF band rate for blind nonidentical asymmetric replicate errors with possible open spectral zero sets. This paper closes the qualitative inference and nonvacuity questions: its fixed-index compatibility condition admits an explicit full causal product law, and its deterministic finite-sieve and abstract exact-class bands are uniformly honest with uniformly vanishing expected maximal width. The remaining upper-side gap is an explicit protected-cube marked inverse modulus; the remaining lower-side gap is a strict-interior fixed-nuisance Bernoulli packet with product-experiment contiguity.
project_justification.niche: The contribution remains in the Stat cluster: identification is enabling, whereas the focal deliverable is simultaneous whole-curve uncertainty quantification over one fixed, nonadaptive, demonstrably nonempty class. Compact treatment support supplies entire transforms, one centered replicate fixes translation, the error moment radius supplies a protected neighborhood, and Sobolev moduli turn expanding-grid channel agreement into qualitative target contraction.
project_justification.fill: The finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic construction profiles simultaneous mass, probability-channel, and marked-channel confidence restrictions over equicontinuous relaxed spline and atomic error sieves. Its maximal expected width is at most \(\widetilde\omega_n+2b_{\mu,n}+2B_Y|\mathcal X|e^{-np_{\min}/8}=o(1)\). The parallel exact-class construction is abstract and noncomputational. An explicit normalized bump, zero response surface, and independent centered asymmetric nonidentical two-point errors certify that both the full causal class and its exact nuisance projection are inhabited. None of these soundness repairs supplies an explicit inverse rate or a lower-bound packet.

body.related_work: The organizing cluster is statistical inference rather than exact identification. Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy provide the unmarked probability-channel cocycle and compact-support density analysis that inform this paper; the present normalized scalar probability submodel is contained in their signal-identification setting but is stricter because it also fixes an error moment radius and centers \(U_2\). Their rate and minimax theorems concern \(L^2\) density risk under additional conditions and do not imply an ADRF supremum-band rate. Huang and Zhang study the error-contaminated continuous-treatment ADRF with an everywhere-nonzero known error transform. Kato and Sasaki study deconvolution bands with auxiliary-error or conventional spectral information, Kato, Sasaki, and Ura study Kotlarski-based inference, and Babii studies honest diameter for fixed linear inverse operators. Hoffmann--Nickl and Bull concern adaptive direct-model bands, whereas this paper fixes \(\beta,R_f,R_q\) and claims no adaptation. Andrews and Mikusheva analyze nearly unidentified sequences; the present fixed compatible class obtains only qualitative contraction and does not cover drifting weak-identification regimes. Low supplies a testing-to-expected-length reduction only after a marked modulus is constructed. The explicit reference law repairs nonvacuity but does not supply that missing quantitative inverse or fixed-nuisance Bernoulli converse.
body.interpretation: The two observed channels identify \(f_x\) and \(q_x\), and therefore the continuous regression quotient \(q_x/f_x\). The structural response representation itself implies conditional unconfoundedness and a common-event bound on the potential-outcome schedule; positivity and causal-mean continuity then support the pointwise causal interpretation on \(I\). The normalized bump and asymmetric two-point error construction show that these conclusions are not artifacts of an empty class. The Melaku--Shi two-recall diet--mortality analysis remains motivation only; coverage applies to it only if its data-generating law satisfies the stated compatibility, support, overlap, structural-response, moment, and smoothness conditions.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The model is explicitly inhabited, redundant primitive causal and boundedness assumptions have been replaced by a proved structural implication, and the causal bridge, analytic cocycle, transform concentration, outer-sieve embedding, clipped honesty, and qualitative finite-sieve contraction remain proved. Compactness yields \(\widetilde\omega_n\to0\) but no numerical inverse modulus. Primitive compatibility does not guarantee the strict Sobolev interior needed by the Bernoulli lower experiment, and even under such interior the packet and product-Hellinger construction remain unresolved.
body.honest_scope: The fixed, nonadaptive model uses a nonempty finite stratum set, compact dose support, a bounded-range structural response surface, Sobolev radii with \(\beta>1/2\), overlap, and independent replicate errors with \(q_e>1\) moments. Compatibility with the explicit bump requires \(R_f\ge R_{f,0}\), \(0<\kappa\le\kappa_0\), and \(0<p_{\min}\le|\mathcal X|^{-1}\); the resulting causal and exact projected classes are proved nonempty. No separate spectral-modulus condition is imposed. The finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic band and the parallel abstract exact-class band are uniformly honest, have width at most \(2B_Y\), and have uniformly \(o(1)\) expected maximal width. No finite decision algorithm, explicit \(O(r_n)\) rate, minimax match, rate elbow, or unconditional converse is asserted.
